description: Formerly Used Defense Sites (FUDS) Projects (Points) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This entity is required by the US Army Corps of Engineers Headquarters program Formerly Used Defense Site in order to link to other US Army Corps of Engineers systems and for reporting purposes. Coverage: the United States. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Spatial planning, Town planning, Buildings, Equipment, Housing. Its keywords are USCG, USACE, IENC, HIFLD, FUDS, risk management. The portal shows 2024-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
